title: Acceptance gate v2: every acceptance path that looks like a test file (any language) must exist and be in the task diff
spec:
Goal T-1403, wave 2, plan label E6v2 (refile of T-1441 so it depends on B2v2 T-1451, which replaced T-1434; the
content is unchanged). Evidence: luna T-0104 passed the gate without backend/test/oauth.test.ts and
google-oauth.test.ts although its acceptance named them (plan.md backlog); fix rounds are 41% of execute runs,
partly missing non-Python acceptance tests (analysis finding 5).

Facts (goal/T-1403 at 92c1a98; acceptance.py and the daemon gate unchanged since main 355583c; re-check daemon.py
line numbers after B2v2 merges):
- orchestrator/acceptance.py:8-11 _TEST_ID only matches tests/<...>.py::name; named_tests() (23-37) and
  missing_tests() (52-66) check that the named Python function is defined. Non-Python paths are never checked.
- orchestrator/daemon.py:1437-1450 gate(): after the dirty-scope check, missing = acceptance.missing_tests(...);
  non-empty -> stamp gated_at, hold gate_red with resume_hint {'failures': ['FAILED path::name (missing: ...)'],
  'missing_tests': missing}, gate_reds += 1, and skip the gate run.
- daemon.py:26-27 changed_paths(task) wraps gitutil.changed_paths (diff base..HEAD names, None when unavailable).
- tests/test_daemon.py:161 patches daemon.acceptance.missing_tests; most daemon gate tests use acceptance like
  ['pass'] with no test-file path, so the new check returns [] for them.

Change:
1. acceptance.py: test_file_paths(acceptance) -> sorted unique paths from whitespace tokens (strip surrounding
   quotes, backticks, brackets and trailing ':,;.'): skip tokens containing '*' or ending in '/'; drop tokens
   containing '::' whose left side ends in '.py' (missing_tests owns those); for other '::' tokens use the left
   side. A token is a test file when it has a file extension and either a path component is exactly 'test',
   'tests' or '__tests__', or the file name matches *.test.<js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|cjs>, *.spec.<same>,
   *Test.swift, *Tests.swift, *Test.kt, *Tests.kt, *Test.java, *Tests.java. '.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh' must not
   match.
   missing_test_files(worktree, acceptance, changed=None) -> paths that are not files under worktree, or (when
   changed is a list) not in changed.
2. daemon.gate(): compute files = acceptance.missing_test_files(worktree, acceptance, changed_paths(t)) next to
   the existing missing_tests call; when either list is non-empty, one gate_red hold whose failures list holds the
   existing lines plus 'FAILED <path> (missing: test file not in task diff)' per file and resume_hint gains
   'missing_test_files': files. Same stamp/gate_reds/_hold_stale_high handling as today; no second code path.
3. roadmap.py's missing_tests call is unchanged.

Tests that assert the old behaviour (SPEC RULE): tests/test_acceptance.py tests (13-75) pin Python-id behaviour and
must pass unchanged; tests/test_failures.py (~32-39) parses 'FAILED ... (missing: test not defined)' lines, keep that
text for Python ids. Run tests/test_acceptance.py, tests/test_failures.py and tests/test_daemon.py.

Depends on B2v2 T-1451 (daemon.py, tests/test_daemon.py).

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused tests in the foreground; never
background a command and never run the full gate. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py
like the neighbouring tests.
acceptance: tests/test_acceptance.py::test_missing_test_files_requires_test_paths_in_diff: passes: acceptance.test_file_paths() extracts backend/test/oauth.test.ts, web/src/a.spec.ts, apple/AppTests/FooTests.swift, android/app/src/test/BarTest.kt and tests/test_x.py (bare, no ::) but not tests/test_x.py::test_y (handled by missing_tests), .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh, globs or directories; missing_test_files(worktree, acceptance, changed) returns those absent from the worktree or not in changed (changed None -> existence only)

tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_holds_when_acceptance_test_file_missing_from_diff: passes: daemon.gate holds a done execute task gate_red with resume_hint.missing_test_files and a 'FAILED <path> (missing: test file not in task diff)' failure line, without running tests-green, when its acceptance names backend/test/oauth.test.ts that the task diff does not contain
